Priya: Preview launch 1: were opening Dedicated A130 micro-pools in Munich (MUC) and Nairobi (NBO) today. Focus: low-latency multilang chat + dynamic quantization profiles. Docs + reservation guidance below. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created pool a130-muc (size=12) and pool a130-nbo (size=8)  rollout id=rl-2026-a130-01
Ravi: Brief summary  whats the benefit vs A100/L-class?
Priya: A130 targets inference with dynamic per-request quant profiles (int8 / mixed-int4) and a thin-KV cache. Customers should see ~25-35% cost reduction for short-chat workloads; large-batch throughput still favors A100.
sales: Pricing note: preview surcharge = +6% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Use code A130-PREVIEW in quotes; enterprise customers can request a waiver via billing case.
billing: Got it  will add line item A130-PREVIEW and set trial credit rules for beta customers. Please include sales case IDs on reservations.
Ravi: Reservation model & preempt policy? Any eviction expectations?
Priya: Phase 0 = invite-only reserved slots + open burst holds (max 5 days). Soft-preempt applies: 20m eviction webhook + optional state-sync hook to attempt KV-cache persist. Auto-fallback routing to nearest compatible pool enabled.
infra-team: Operational tags required: region, project, quant_profile (e.g., `region=muc project=chatbot quant_profile=int8`). Untagged holds will be auto-cancelled after 10h. Nightly cleanup removes stale holds.
eng-oncall: Monitor rules created: metric pool.a130-*-utilization >= 80% for 12m -> page #eng-oncall. If kv-cache-miss-rate > 5% escalate to #infra. P95 latency tracked per-model.
Priya: CLI snippet for engs/customers:
```
# list a130 pools in Munich
redwoodctl pools list --filter "a130" --region muc
# reserve 2 GPUs for 48h with int8 profile
redwoodctl reservations create --pool a130-muc --count 2 --duration 48h --meta quant_profile=int8 --tags project=chatbot
# cancel reservation
redwoodctl reservations cancel --id <reservation-id>
```
sales: Heads-up: call out model-compatibility. Some legacy model builds require a recompile to use mixed-int4 paths; include compatibility matrix link in quotes.
Priya: Customer doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/a130-preview  contains reservation flow, quant profile guide, eviction webhook schema, pricing, and migration checklist. Dashboard link will be appended by EOD.
Ravi: SLA?
Priya: Uptime SLA unchanged for Dedicated. Doc will mark these pools as "preview-limited-capacity" and include guidance on expected availability.
Priya: Thanks team  please escalate issues to #eng-oncall and tag reservations with sales case IDs for billing reconciliation. :pray:
